method: Static inspection of complete Git tree and retrieved source files; constrained changelog traversal and SQL lexical extraction, not Liquibase or PostgreSQL execution.
limits: Counts describe declarations in a source snapshot, not installed objects.
Function tracking uses the last located definition by name; validate overloads and permissions with PostgreSQL catalog.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS and conditional blocks require verification against preexisting state.
DEFAULT partition inherits parent columns; monthly partitions are dynamic and not counted as installed.
No original implementation files, credentials, row data or secret values are copied into this artifact.
